text:
I am glad you found your way here today, young <class>.  The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature.  Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges.  We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own.  Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!
Heeding the Call

Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.

He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

Ready yourself!
Child of Nature

Greetings, young <race>. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?

Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
Child of Nature

Greetings, young <class>. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
Speak with Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind.

Greetings, fellow <class>. It pleases me to meet a fellow <class> from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.

I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
Moonglade

All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young <class>.

The Great Cat Spirit

It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
